title: bouteloua simplex var. rahmeri
intro: Bouteloua simplex var. rahmeri, commonly known as Blue Grama Grass, is a type of perennial grass native to the Southwestern United States. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Blue Grama Grass are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
